heading: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' box office collection Day 17 (LIVE): Pankaj Tripathi and Ravi Kishan starrer eyeing to gross over Rs 260 crore amid 'Hanuman Ansh' buzz
author: TOI Entertainment Desk / etimes.in / Updated: Sep 20, 2026, 20:48 IST
paragraphs: 'Mirzapur: The Movie', starring Pankaj Tripathi, Ali Fazal, Ravi Kishan, Divyenndu, and Jitendra Kumar, enjoyed a successful run at the box office for two weeks since its release in theatres
Now, the movie is in its third week at the cinemas, adding decent numbers to its overall box office tally

Here's how the big screen adaptation of a web show is performing on its third Sunday at the cinemas.Mirzapur Movie Review'Mirzapur: The Movie' box office collection Day 17 (LIVE)According to the Sacnilk report, on Day 17, the gangster drama is currently running across 3,694 shows in India
It has collected a net of Rs 3.91 crore as of now on Day 17

The numbers are expected to increase as the day progresses.With that, the total India gross collections are now Rs 255.55 crore, and the total India net collections have reached Rs 214.61 crore so far

The India final collections are yet to be reported.Day/week-wise collection (India net)Week 1: Rs 148.45 croreWeek 2: Rs 55 croreDay 15: Rs 2.75 croreDay 16: Rs 4.50 croreDay 17: Rs 3.91 crore (LIVE)Total: Rs 214.61 croreWorldwide collection of 'Mirzapur: The Movie'By day 16, the film has collected Rs 51.25 crore overseas, pushing the worldwide gross collection to Rs 302.19 crore
The overseas collection for Day 17 is yet to be reported.More about 'Mirzapur: The Movie'Directed by Gurmeet Singh, it is an adaptation of the web series, 'Mirzapur'
The makers made a few changes in the storyline of the film, with new faces joining the project

Jitendra Kumar replaced Vikrant Massey as Bablu Pandit, while Ravi Kishan joined as Babban Babua.The film also stars Rasika Dugal, Shriya Pilgaonkar, Shweta Tripathi, Sonal Chauhan, Sheeba Chaddha, Anangsha Biswas, Sushant Singh, Abhishek Banerjee, and Kulbhushan Kharbanda
It was released in theatres on September 4, 2026.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and data in this article are compiled from diverse public and industry sources
All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance
These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized
